content: TCP provides connection-oriented reliable ordered delivery, while UDP provides a lightweight datagram service without built-in delivery guarantees.
HTTP is an application protocol for web communication. HTTPS is HTTP protected by TLS, providing encryption and server authentication.
interview_relevance: Explain TLS at a high level.

content: DNS maps domain names to network information such as IP addresses using a distributed hierarchical naming system.
IP addresses identify network interfaces for packet routing. IPv4 uses 32-bit addresses and IPv6 uses 128-bit addresses.
TCP establishes a connection using SYN, SYN-ACK, and ACK messages before normal data transfer.
interview_relevance: Explain sequence numbers and connection establishment.

content: REST-style APIs expose resources through HTTP methods and representations, commonly using GET, POST, PUT/PATCH, and DELETE.
HTTP status codes communicate request outcomes. 2xx indicates success, 4xx client-side issues, and 5xx server-side failures.
WebSockets provide a persistent bidirectional communication channel between a client and server after an HTTP-based handshake.
